title: The Martyrdom of St. Eugenia
subtitle: As Alban Butler tells it
source: Alban Butler, The Lives of the Fathers, Martyrs, and Other Principal Saints, vol. XII (London: John Murphy), December 25, p. 321, public domain. Read from the page images of archive.org's scan of the printing, word by word against a second scan of the same printing; where they differ, the printed page is followed. Butler's footnotes, the note of his sources under each heading and the running heads are left out, and his italics are set plain; the paragraphs are as printed.

sections.title: The Lives of the Saints, December 25
sections.citation: Alban Butler, The Lives of the Fathers, Martyrs, and Other Principal Saints, vol. XII (London: John Murphy), December 25, p. 321
paragraphs: She suffered at Rome under Valerian about the year 257, and is mentioned by St. Avitus, though we have no authentic acts of her sufferings, those recited by Metaphrastes and Surius deserving no notice. She is also mentioned in the lives of SS. Protus and Hyacinthus, MM. on the eleventh of September, p. 116.
